guard_pose: calm magic stance facing right, right hand raised forward with the palm open, a green grimoire floating in the air just above it, cape flowing behind him

jab: quick wind palm: snaps his open palm straight forward with a gust of green wind, then pulls it back into the stance; the grimoire keeps floating near his hand
jab2: second wind palm: thrusts the other open palm straight forward with a twist of the hips and a puff of green wind, then back into the stance
jab3: wind kick: lifts the front knee and kicks straight forward at belly height, thin blades of green wind swirling off the foot, then back into the stance
dashattack: gliding wind rush: rides a gust of green wind forward, leaning low with one shoulder leading inside a spiral of wind, then slows down and stands back up in the stance
fsmash: wind blast palm: draws his hand back as green wind spirals around his arm, then thrusts the open palm forward at full extension releasing a short burst of slicing green wind, then recovers into the stance
usmash: rising gust: crouches, then sweeps both open hands straight up above his head as a short column of whirling green wind blades shoots upward, then back into the stance
dsmash: wind sweep: drops low and sweeps one leg along in front of him with a blade of green wind, then spins and sweeps behind him, then back into the stance
nair: neutral aerial: spins once in mid-air inside a ring of slicing green wind blades whirling close around his body, then opens up again
fair: forward aerial: a powerful flying kick straight forward in mid-air wrapped in a spiral of green wind, then pulls the leg back in
dair: down aerial: stomps straight down beneath him with both feet in mid-air with a downward burst of green wind blades, then pulls the legs back up

nspecial: Swallow's Cutlass: the floating grimoire flips open and glows green, he sweeps his raised hand forward and three small swallow-shaped blades of green wind fly out ahead of him in a narrow fan, then he returns to the stance
sspecial: Tornado Fang: the grimoire glows, he circles his hand and thrusts it forward, a small spinning green whirlwind full of wind blades forms in front of him and twists slowly forward, then he returns to the stance
uspecial: takes flight on the wind: green wind swirls around his feet, he crouches, then shoots upward wrapped in a streaking green gust, body stretched upward and arms close, cape whipping below him, ending in flight with the legs hanging
dspecial: Whirlwind: spreads his arms and spins on the spot as a ring of slicing green wind whirls close around his whole body, then the whirlwind bursts outward, then he returns to the stance
ultimate: Spirit Storm: green wind gathers around him, he raises one hand high and a storm of swirling green wind and wind blades spins around his body, growing stronger and stronger, then he swings his arm down and the storm bursts outward in a flash of green wind, then the wind dies down and he returns to the stance
w0_nspecial: Swallow's Cutlass with the four-leaf grimoire: the grimoire glows bright and a four-leaf clover shines on its cover, he sweeps his hand forward and five small swallow-shaped blades of green wind fan out ahead of him, then he returns to the stance
w0_ultimate: Wind Blade Shower: raises one hand high above his head, the glowing grimoire flips its pages, many thin green wind blades form in the air just above him and shoot down in front of him like rain, then he swings his hand down and one big blade of wind falls, then he returns to the stance
w1_sspecial: Spirit Dive: a long spear of swirling green wind forms in his hand, he crouches, then dives forward wrapped in a spiralling gust, thrusting the wind spear three times in quick succession, then one final powerful thrust, then settles back into the stance
w1_ultimate: Spirit of Zephyr: green wind spirals around him and gathers into a long spear of whirling wind above his shoulder, pulling the air toward it, he draws it back and hurls it forward with a powerful overhand throw, then he returns to the stance

notes: makeYuno: buildBrawlerNormals(S=0.97, P=1.1, fx=Wind) -> jab3 exists; no baseWeapon (the grimoire is only in the guard picture), 2 air jumps. Overrides: open-palm jabs to match the raised-hand guard, and every normal that carries the Wind fx (jab3, dashattack, smashes, fair, dair) plus nair recoloured green wind; ftilt/utilt/dtilt/bair/uair stay the generic kicks/uppercut. Specials: nspecial 'Lames de vent' 3 WindBlades at f10/34 (named Swallow's Cutlass, his wind-blade spell); sspecial 'Tempete tranchante' slow piercing Tornado that pulls, at f14/46; uspecial 'Envol de Sylphe' dashes 20 in the stick direction at f8, body hit f8-22, no gravity, helpless after -> pin None, ends in the air; dspecial 'Tourbillon' 4 hits around him f8-27 + finisher f30-34/50. w0 'Grimoire a quatre trefles' replaces nspecial (5 blades), jab (exists) and ultimate (PLUIE DE LAMES: blades rain on every foe from f36, giant blade f88/104). w1 'Lance de l'esprit' (WindSpear) replaces sspecial (Spirit Dive) , jab (exists) and ultimate (LANCE DE ZEPHYR: projectile at f54/96, pulls). Base ultimate TEMPETE DE ZEPHYR (UltFx SpiritStorm). Sylph (Bell) is left out of every prompt on purpose: PixelLab would draw a second character.
